Title: Potential buffer risk: char
Description: Statically-sized arrays can be improperly restricted, leading to potential overflows or other issues (CWE-119!/CWE-120).

Title: Potential integer risk: atoi
Description: Unless checked, the resulting number can exceed the expected range (CWE-190).

Title: Potential misc risk: fopen
Description: Check when opening files - can an attacker redirect it (via symlinks), force the opening of special file type (e.g., device files), move things around to create a race condition, control its ancestors, or change its contents? (CWE-362).
